title: Implement a Trie (prefix tree) in Rust
description: Implement a Trie data structure supporting insert, search (exact), and starts_with (prefix) operations.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement a Trie in src/lib.rs using `HashMap<char, TrieNode>` nodes:
- Each node has `children: HashMap<char, TrieNode>` and `is_end: bool`
- `insert`: walk/create nodes for each char, set last node's `is_end = true`
- `search`: walk nodes for each char, return `node.is_end` at the end (false if any char missing)
- `starts_with`: same walk but return `true` if all prefix chars exist (don't check `is_end`)
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
